instagram.title: Restaurangernas AI-bilder på mat väcker ilska
instagram.caption:
På sociala medier riktas kritik mot restauranger som har AI-bilder på menyn – där beskrivs de som "äckliga, fula och ett brott mot mänskligheten".

"Jag kommer aldrig gå till ett ställe som använder AI-bilder i marknadsföringen, man vet inte riktigt vad man får", säger Tindra Svalö till SVT Nyheter Helsingborg.

Men restaurangägarna själva anser att bilderna kan gynna verksamheten.

Se mer via länken i vår profil.
instagram.caption_en: On social media, restaurants with AI images on their menus are criticised, described as "disgusting, ugly and a crime against humanity". "I will never go to a place that uses AI images in its marketing, you don't really know what you're getting," Tindra Svalö tells SVT Nyheter Helsingborg. But the restaurant owners themselves think the images can benefit their business.
instagram.quotes: Quotes Jenny Frennberg's reel (archived on this site), the Guardian article, and a YouTube commentator; Nils Holmberg appears at 0:26-0:38.
instagram.processing: Downloaded with yt-dlp without login (progressive H.264/AAC 720x1280 rendition rather than the VP9 1080p DASH stream, for browser compatibility); remuxed with faststart. Swedish subtitles are burned into the picture, so only English and German tracks are offered; the Swedish transcript follows the burned-in text and the audio.
